result.brief: 提出混合分辨率视频扩散生成方法，通过双分辨率注意力、混合分辨率潜空间解码器与自选高分辨率区域，在仅处理30%全分辨率token时实现约4.8倍去噪加速并保持接近全分辨率的画质。
result.reason: Mixed-resolution video diffusion transformer with dual-resolution attention and mixed-resolution latent decoder; directly targets video generation efficiency and latent representation handling.
